notes: gold_anchors are verbatim phrases (whitespace/quote-normalized, case-insensitive) that occur exactly once in the episode transcript.
One anchor = the gold passage contains it. Two anchors = the gold span runs from the first to the second (host question plus guest answer).
The eval script resolves anchors to character offsets in episodes.clean_text after cleaning; a retrieved chunk counts as a passage-level hit if its [start_char,end_char] overlaps the span.
Answers are intentionally not stored: M1 checks citation validity against gold_episode/anchors, and quality is scored manually on ~10 questions.
